# Codewars

> > Codewars is a coding practice platform where developers solve Kata challenges to improve their programming skills across languages like Python, Java, C#, and SQL.

The platform features Codewars Red premium subscription, Code Runner for testing solutions, GitHub integration, and community-driven learning. Founded by Jake Hoffner, it emphasizes mastery learning and learning in public methodologies.

## Key Topics

- Kata challenges
- Coding practice
- Codewars Red subscription
- Code Runner
- GitHub integration
- Python
- Java
- C#
- SQL
- Learn in Public
- Mastery Learning
- Programming education
- Platform updates
- Community learning
- Career development

## Getting Started

- [Codewars Blog - Developer Resources and Insights](https://wf.codewars.com/blog): Main blog hub with developer insights, career advice, and platform updates
- [8 Reasons Why Codewarriors Practice Coding with Codewars](https://wf.codewars.com/post/8-reasons-why-codewarriors-practice-coding-with-codewars): User testimonials on Kata challenges and coding practice benefits
- [Codewars Red](https://wf.codewars.com/subscription): Codewars Red premium subscription with enhanced Kata features and benefits

## Platform Updates & Product News

- [Category: Product News](https://wf.codewars.com/blog-categories/codewars): Product News category archive page
- [What's new in Codewars: Q4 2023 to January 2024](https://wf.codewars.com/post/release-notes-issue-1-q4-2023-to-january-2024): Q4 2023-January 2024 updates: Code Runner, API improvements, Go & Factor
- [What's new in Codewars: April highlights](https://wf.codewars.com/post/whats-new-in-codewars-april-highlights): April product updates covering Code Runner, GitHub integration, and bug fixes
- [How many Kata did you complete in 2024?](https://wf.codewars.com/post/how-many-kata-did-you-complete-in-2024): 2024 year-in-review celebrating community growth and Kata completion stats

## Learning & Education

- [Learn in Public: The community-based learning strategy that improves programming skills](https://wf.codewars.com/post/learn-in-public-the-community-based-learning-strategy-that-improves-programming-skills): Community-based learning strategy by Shawn Wang for developer growth
- [What is Mastery Learning, and How Does It Apply to Coding?](https://wf.codewars.com/post/what-is-mastery-learning-and-how-does-it-apply-to-coding): Benjamin Bloom's Mastery Learning framework applied to coding education
- [7 Resources to Level Up with Python for Data Science](https://wf.codewars.com/post/7-resources-to-level-up-with-python-for-data-science): Python data science learning resources including A Byte of Python guide

## Career Development

- [10 Traits Employers Look for When Hiring Software Engineers](https://wf.codewars.com/post/10-traits-employers-look-for-when-hiring-software-engineers): CEO Jake Hoffner's insights on technical and soft skills for hiring
- [How to Begin a New Career as a Software Engineer](https://wf.codewars.com/post/how-to-begin-a-new-career-as-a-software-engineer): Career transition guide covering bootcamps and self-teaching paths
